posts.transcript: The SASS apocalypse, the narrative when it really all started was why the hell would I pay sales force and when and I love using this example like Chamath started this company called AM 90 and the whole pitch was we'll give you software that's 80% is good for 90% lower cost. So I'm paying sales force $1,000,000 a year. Why don't they pay Chammas like crappy Salesforce $100,000 a year? And we have seen the complete opposite from our estimates. We see our customers. They are happy to pay us actually more for their existing software. Yeah, way more because it's not about cost saving, it's all about revenue generation. And so coming back to this straight forward that we keep talking about, he was running his business and he's doing an at ten, $20 million of revenue. If your core business operations run way faster because you have software that's designed for your business, your revenue goes up and so.
posts.description:
This is the first time I've spoken publicly about getting acquired by AWS, why we're building Hercules, and my journey as an entrepreneur.

Honored to do it with my friend, Moritz Plassnig (CEO CloudBees) as he launches Codeship Labs.

Watch the full interview at https://lnkd.in/dzuhHmWv
